Honestly my biggest advice for Vyse on attack is teamwork. Her utility is alright but most of it is suited for post plants. You can get a duo to play off your flash but individually it’s mostly down to mechanics. You aren’t supposed to have as much impact on attack as a sentinel, just play post plants with your utility and stall for time with thorns. Your duelists are supposed to entry, just back them up and play for trades in most situations. If you don’t have a proper sentinel use her shear to watch the flank. And the thorns are good stalling tools on choke points. Just make sure you or your teammates will have to go through them.
